title: Rules for Austin's biggest water users
subtitle: Where Austin Water's proposal stands, and what is due next
alt: Timeline of Austin Water's proposed rules for high-impact water users: in July 2026 the City Council passed a resolution on large water users; on October 5 Austin Water held an open house proposing rules for customers using more than 85 million gallons a year; recommendations are due to the Council's Climate, Water, Environment and Parks Committee by December 9; the first report on large users' water consumption is due by May 2027.
